character: Highwire is the storm-relay town cut into the Tri Peaks' deepslate: every Pokemon here is Electric or a mountain bird, and the town lives on charge. Its workers keep the lamps, the relay, the siren and the telegraph running; the rest gather where the current is (round the pylon, in a crate of look-alike Poke Balls, on the lightning rods).
authored_by: town author A, 2026-10-05, by hand; positions measured from derived/towns/gym3_town_plan.json, gym3_town_placement.json, derived/plaza_centres/gym3_town.json and tools/ground.py (rounded) through tools/ambient.py's Site; the square is not cut (plaza y 174, ground 174), so Site's y is the paving's; y in a situation is the standing y

workers.interact: The Magnemite is topping up the plaza's lamp. The townsfolk say it has never once let one go out in a storm.
The Klang has fitted itself into the relay's spare gearbox at the edge of the square and turns there, keeping it run in.
The Pawmo carries lightning rods from the spares stall to the gym's roof crew, one under each arm, and it tingles.
The Ampharos stands at the sighting post and flashes its tail: three long, three short. Somewhere on the next peak, a light answers.
The signal clerk's Electrike runs each message from the telegraph to the square, fast enough that its fur crackles.
The Rotom lives in the telegraph box on the clerk's corner and taps out the relay's traffic itself. The clerk mostly reads.
The Electabuzz splices the gym's feed line with its bare hands. The lights inside flicker once and hold.
The Pikachu charges the storm siren's battery from its cheeks, a jolt at a time. It will not let anyone else do it.
The Flaaffy carries a bale of shorn Mareep wool to the square for insulation. Some of it is its own.
The Tadbulb hangs over the path to the Mart as its street lamp, brightening every time someone walks under it.
The Togedemaru stands under the Mart's lightning rod with its spike raised, catching the static that runs down it.

pets.why: the signal clerk's Pichu follows her and sneezes sparks
and a Yamper that waits by the telegraph, barking at every message
the counter keeper's Pachirisu sits on the counter and is the reason nobody touches the till
and a Dedenne that follows the keeper, picking up radio from her pocket set with its whiskers
the spares seller's Morpeko waits by the stall and turns hungry, and then angry, by lunchtime

placed.why: an Emolga on the ridge, ready to glide down to the lane
a Plusle in the corner house's window
and a Minun in the Pokemon Center's window across the lane, the two of them cheering each other
a Helioptile basking on the warm flagstones at the gym's foot, frills out to the sun (the gym is not in the placement, so measured)
a Noibat hanging asleep from the gutter
a Pidove on the Pokemon Center's roof, puffed against the wind off the peaks
a Shinx on the Mart's step, its eyes glinting
a Pikipek on the Mart roof, drilling the eaves
a Rufflet on the Mart's eave, facing down the wind

situations.title: Warming hands at the pylon
situations.story: Six Mareep stand in a ring round the relay pylon. Each time it hums, their wool puffs up a size, and on cold mornings the townsfolk come and stand among them to warm their hands.
situations.why: the ring is the situation; gym3_relay_pylon's columns are x 1688-1690, z 1396-1398, so every member stands clear of them

situations.title: The web on the corner
situations.story: A Galvantula has strung a web across the corner between the end house and the gym's wall and sleeps in it by day; three Joltik sit in the strands, eating the static the web catches.
situations.why: the strip between gym3_house_04 and the gym anchor; kept from the old roster's 'Galvantula asleep in its web corner'

situations.title: Not for sale
situations.story: The crate of Poke Balls outside the Mart has three in it that are Voltorb. The clerk has stopped selling from that crate.
situations.why: against the Mart's west wall, outside its anchor (x 1674+)

situations.title: Knock knock
situations.story: Two Pawmi press their paws to the Mart's door handle until it shocks them, squeak, and do it again.
situations.why: beside the Mart's door (1685, 1444), which faces north, outside its anchor

situations.title: Practice behind the Mart
situations.story: A Toxtricity plays its chest like a guitar behind the Mart every evening. One Toxel sits in front of it and has never missed a set.
situations.why: east of the Mart's anchor (x 1697), the town's quietest corner

notes: Supersedes idle.towns.gym3_town (Snorlax and Purrloin gone; the Galvantula's web corner kept and given its Joltik). surge_magnemite_lamp is kept with its id and record unchanged. Eleven workers (three carriers) is over data/ambient.json rules.per_town (2 carriers, 4 stationary).
